caption: The drawing features three distinct objects rendered in thin, black lines on a beige background. On the left side, there is a side view of a bench with two legs and two armrests that curve upwards and end in spiral or hooked shapes. The bench seat is indicated with a dashed line. To the right of the bench, there is a frontal view of a chair or stool, which shows a rectangular frame with a horizontal backrest at the top and two curved crossbars below it, as well as two straight legs. Above both these objects, near the top-center of the drawing, there is a decorative element: a horizontal, elongated design consisting of two bands that curve outward and a central ornament featuring a symmetrical petal or leaf motif, flanked by cross-hatched and patterned sections. All objects are enclosed within a double-lined rectangular border. The artist's signature, "N. Faris," appears in the lower left corner inside the border.
title: Window Seat
